$Comment: The Great Turkey dazed after a charge that misses or that a block stops: the game's stun stars over its head, and it takes half again the physical damage, which is the players' opening. Harvest_Feast_Template_Great_Turkey (NPC/Roles/Harvest_Feast/Templates) puts it on the Great Turkey as its daze starts. It is the game's Goblin_Feastmaster_Stunned with the stars on the turkey's Head node. Keep Duration equal to the template's CombatStunTime; Amount is the change to its physical resistance as a fraction (below zero, it takes more).
